home.seo_p1: At OWNEO we revolutionise the concept of luxury supercar sharing in Spain, making the dream of driving the world's most exclusive vehicles a reality.
home.seo_p1_body: Our exclusive fleet includes the most coveted Ferrari supercars, the power of a Lamborghini or the full Porsche range: the 911 Turbo S, the electric Taycan and the Cayenne and Macan sport SUVs.
home.seo_p2_body: Discover the refinement of the Aston Martin DB11, the aerodynamic innovation of the McLaren 720S, or the supreme luxury of the Rolls-Royce Wraith. Complete your experience with the craftsmanship of the Bentley Continental GT or the power of the Mercedes-AMG GT R, known as 'The Beast of the Green Hell'.
home.seo_footer: From sharing a Ferrari in Barcelona to a Lamborghini in Marbella, OWNEO gives you the opportunity to live unique experiences behind the wheel of the world's finest supercars. Discover why we are leaders in luxury car sharing and supercar experiences in Spain.
home.intro_para: A brand that redefines access to high-end cars through shared ownership: an efficient, modern and aspirational model, aligned with the new way of understanding mobility.
home.comparison_insurance: Insurance and maintenance at your expense
home.comparison_tagline: No commitment. No lock-in. Pure experience.
